title: How a photo travels
lede: Three paths through one photo service: uploading a photo, sharing it with a friend, and the friend opening it.

app.label: Photo app
app.description: The owner's photo app. It takes the photo, uploads it, and is where the owner decides who to share it with.

upload.label: Upload API
upload.description: The service's front door. Every request from an app is signed, so the service knows which account it comes from.

scanner.label: Safety scan
scanner.description: An outside safety service. It checks each new file for malware and abuse before anything else touches it.

resizer.label: Resizer
resizer.description: Makes a thumbnail and the sizes screens ask for, so nobody downloads the full original just to see a preview.

rules.label: Sharing rules
rules.description: Records who may see which photo, and until when. Only the owner, through the service, can change them.

store.label: Photo store
store.description: Keeps each original and its sizes. Nothing in it is visible to anyone until a sharing rule allows it.

friend.label: Friend's app
friend.description: The app of someone the owner shared with. It can only ask to see photos; it never changes the rules.

gateway.label: View gateway
gateway.description: Every view goes through here. It checks the sharing rules, fetches the right size, and logs who looked.

paths.name: Upload path
paths.summary: A photo leaves the phone, is checked, and is stored in every size it will be shown at.

steps.title: The owner uploads a photo
steps.text: The app sends the original photo over a signed request, so the service knows which account it belongs to.

steps.title: The photo is scanned
steps.text: An outside safety service checks the file for malware and abuse before anything else touches it. A photo that fails is refused.

steps.title: Smaller sizes are made
steps.text: The resizer makes a thumbnail and the sizes phones and screens ask for, so nobody downloads the full original to see a preview.

steps.title: Everything is stored
steps.text: The original and its sizes are stored together. Nothing is shared yet: only the owner can see it.

steps.title: The owner sees it in their album
steps.text: The app is told the upload finished and shows the photo in the owner's album.

paths.name: Sharing path
paths.summary: Only the owner decides who sees a photo, and that decision is a rule the service enforces.

steps.title: The owner shares with a friend
steps.label: share with Sam
steps.text: In the app, the owner picks a photo and a friend to share it with.

steps.title: A sharing rule is written
steps.text: The service records who may see which photo, and until when. The friend's app never writes rules itself.

steps.title: The gateway learns of the invitation
steps.text: The view gateway is told there is a new invitation for this friend.

steps.title: The friend is invited
steps.label: invitation
steps.text: The friend's app shows the invitation, with the owner's name and a preview.

paths.name: Viewing path
paths.summary: Every view is checked against the owner's rules and logged.

steps.title: The friend opens the photo
steps.text: The friend taps the invitation. Their app asks the view gateway for the photo.

steps.title: The rule is checked
steps.text: The gateway asks the sharing rules whether this friend may see this photo now. If the owner removed the share, the answer is no.

steps.title: The right size is fetched
steps.text: The gateway takes the size that fits the friend's screen from the store.

steps.title: The friend sees the photo
steps.text: The photo is shown, and the view is logged so the owner can see who looked.
